benchmarks.title: Hardware benchmarks
benchmarks.intro: Ordinary-lane medians for Qwen3.8 Flash Next. Local cost and break-even follow the hours, electricity, and API prices you set.
benchmarks.modelNote: Qwen3.8 Flash Next · one stream · read, then write
benchmarks.priceNote: Default API prices are $0.10 per million reading tokens and $0.64 per million writing tokens. At a 90/10 mix that blend matches the published API-value column. Change either price to match the API you actually pay.
benchmarks.method1: Daily capacity is active hours times the blended rate. Time is sequential: reading share divided by read tok/s, plus writing share divided by write tok/s.
benchmarks.method2: Energy per day is whole-node watts times hours times your electricity price.
benchmarks.method3: Local cost per million tokens is energy plus hardware spread over the life you set, divided by daily capacity. A discrete GPU rig in this table is the card price plus a $1,200 host.
benchmarks.method4: Break-even days are the rig price divided by API value per day minus energy per day. That is a comparison with the API prices above, not a promise of savings.
benchmarks.dualNote: Dual-GPU rows need chassis clearance, power headroom, and multi-GPU scheduling.
